notes: EBIT is proxied as Income from operations from the consolidated statements of operations. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

D&A and capex are taken from the consolidated statements of cash flows: depreciation and amortization; and purchases of property, plant and equipment. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Net working capital (NWC) is constructed as (Operating current assets excluding cash) minus (Operating current liabilities excluding operating lease liabilities), and includes deferred revenues as an operating working-capital liability; this is a model-specific definition and may differ from other DCF conventions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714925000012/algn-20241231.htm))

Forecast base case margin and growth drivers are assumptions (not explicit management guidance) designed to reflect the FY 2023-2025 trend: slowing growth and EBIT margin compression in FY 2025, with gradual stabilization thereafter. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

WACC is a modeling assumption (0.09) rather than a filing-provided value; terminal growth is set to 0.02 as a long-run nominal/real proxy consistent with developed-market medical devices. (Assumption.)

Terminal exit EV/EBITDA multiple uses a market snapshot proxy (14.38) rather than a comp-media NTM median; this may not perfectly match a true forward exit multiple. ([gurufocus.com](https://www.gurufocus.com/term/enterprise-value-to-ebitda/ALGN))

Investments and comps multiples are set to null because the automated package did not capture EV/NTM revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, and P/E NTM for peers from accessible free sources (would typically require a paid terminal or consensus dataset).

NOL balance is populated using disclosed foreign net operating loss carryforwards of approximately $4.7 million; NOL utilization percent is set to 0.80 as an assumption (placeholder) rather than an explicitly disclosed utilization rate. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Debt is set to 0 because the balance-sheet view captured in the selected filings did not show borrowings/notes payable as a debt line item; lease liabilities are not treated as 'debt' in this DCF input package. (Assumption based on line-item presentation.) ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

catalysts: Regulatory/product and workflow execution: continued rollout of iTero Lumina restorative capabilities and further Align Digital Platform enhancements. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

IP developments: Unified Patent Court preliminary injunction against Angelalign’s “Live Now” feature issued Feb 12, 2026 (with daily payment/cessation terms). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Manufacturing/technology scaling progress from direct fabrication initiatives (Cubicure) and related pilots in 2026. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))
company_overview: Align is the manufacturer of the Invisalign System clear aligners and a provider of related digital workflows, including ClinCheck treatment planning. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Align’s Align Digital Platform integrates digital treatment planning and implementation across patients, orthodontists, GPs and lab partners. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

More than 95% of Invisalign prescription orders are submitted via digital scan, which improves treatment planning timing and removes the upfront PVS impression shipping step. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Align also sells iTero intraoral scanners and iTero software; iTero Lumina launched in Jan 2024 and added restorative capabilities (including NIRI) in 2025. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))
current_context: FY 2025 net revenues were $4,034,964,000 and income from operations was $545,755,000 (EBIT margin ~0.135). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))
Capital expenditures are guided at $125,000,000 to $150,000,000 for the next 12 months. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Management notes operating margin pressure in 2025 driven by lower gross margin and higher marketing/media expense and credit card transaction fees. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Digital-order penetration (95%+ via digital scan) supports end-to-end workflow efficiency and helps strengthen utilization/throughput dynamics. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Product roadmap focus: enhancements to the Align Digital Platform, including restorative capabilities on iTero Lumina and AI-enabled radiograph analysis. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Operational model includes regional manufacturing and treatment planning facilities intended to support scale and responsiveness to regional demand. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

DCF base case assumes low-to-mid single digit revenue growth with gradual EBIT margin stabilization toward ~15% as operating discipline offsets revenue/ASP headwinds. (Assumption; derived from recent FY trend.)

Terminal value uses an exit EBITDA multiple consistent with market pricing for Align (EV/EBITDA snapshot used as proxy). ([gurufocus.com](https://www.gurufocus.com/term/enterprise-value-to-ebitda/ALGN))
key_risks: Margin pressure risk: operating margin in 2025 declined due to lower gross margin and higher marketing/media expense and credit card transaction fees. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Competitive and pricing risk (including ASP volatility) may prevent stabilization of profitability. (Assumption; consistent with FY 2025 vs FY 2024 deterioration.) ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Patent/litigation uncertainty and adverse outcomes could affect product freedom-to-operate and investor sentiment; Align states it cannot predict lawsuit outcomes. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

valuation_summary: DCF base case chains from FY 2025 revenue growth (slowdown) and normalizes EBIT margin from ~13.5% toward ~15% without assuming rapid step-change leverage. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Incremental cash conversion is modeled using a conservative capital intensity (capex ~2.5% of sales) anchored to FY 2025 cash capex. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1097149/000109714926000014/algn-20251231.htm))

Terminal assumptions are designed to be economically plausible for a mature, regulated medical device franchise; the exit multiple is anchored to a current EV/EBITDA snapshot. ([gurufocus.com](https://www.gurufocus.com/term/enterprise-value-to-ebitda/ALGN))
